name: Aldren Precision Tapered Chrome Trouser
description: Tailored-looking tapered trousers in heather grey synth-wool with a clean front crease and invisible side-seam zips from knee to ankle — allowing the lower leg to be opened flat for aug servicing without disturbing the overall silhouette. From across a room they look like office trousers. The material has just enough give at the hip and thigh to accommodate most sub-military aug frames.
functionality: Hidden knee-to-ankle side zips allow full lower-leg access for servicing without removing the trouser. Hip-flex panel accommodates aug joint range.
what_it_says: You keep your chrome out of sight and your appearance professional.
worn_by: anyone who needs to look clean-cut while managing augmentation
story_hooks: A mid-level corporate analyst wears these every day; nobody in the office knows she has prosthetic legs, and she'd like to keep it that way.
The hidden zips can be locked with a small pin — someone's pant was forced open while they were unconscious.
